title: embeddings-rerank-incident-scratch-ryan-cho-2026-03-18
content:
Summary:
- Notes while triaging a noisy rerank/embeddings incident. Seeing intermittent dimension-mismatch errors followed by latency spikes (~3-8s p95) on /v1/rerank endpoint. Issue started 2026-03-16 22:30 UTC and recurred in shorter bursts overnight.

Observed symptoms:
- Client error logs show: "embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536 got 768" for ~0.6% of requests during spikes.
- Latency: baseline p95 ~120ms; during bursts p95 jumps to 3.2s then up to 8.1s in worst window.
- Traces show retries and fallback to CPU path for a subset of requests.
- Coincident increase in queue length on GPU worker pool 'rerank-gpu-prod-2'.
- No clear correlation with traffic volume increases (QPS steady).

Hypotheses (brainstorm):
1) Model/encoder version mismatch: some workers running an older embedding model (768-dim) while rerank service expects 1536-dim vectors. Could be a partial rollout gone wrong.
2) Client upstream sending legacy embeddings (unlikely but possible for some batched callers).
3) Inference runtime returning quantized/compressed embeddings incorrectly expanded on fast path -> dimension truncation.
4) Memory corruption or buffer reuse bug under high batching leading to truncated vectors.
5) Routing/fallback causing mixing of model families (faiss index built for 1536 but some calls using 768).

Commands / checks I ran (timestamps UTC):
- curl -X POST https://internal-api/rerank/debug/health -d '{"pool":"rerank-gpu-prod-2"}' -> pool healthy, utilization 72%. (2026-03-17T01:10)
- Checked worker metadata: kubectl -n inference get pods -l pool=rerank-gpu-prod-2 -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.metadata.annotations.model-version}
' -> found pod rerank-gpu-prod-2-7f4c had model-version: v1.3.1 and rerank-gpu-prod-2-892b had model-version: v1.2.9 (2026-03-17T01:22)
- Query logs for embedding sizes: bigquery query on embeddings_logs: SELECT size, count(*) FROM logs WHERE service='rerank' AND ts>'2026-03-16T22:00' GROUP BY size -> returned sizes 1536 (99.4%), 768 (0.6%) (2026-03-17T01:40)
- Sampling raw payloads for recent errors: grep -A3 "dimension mismatch" /var/log/rerank/errors.log -> payloads show client_id and embedding length field = 768 (2026-03-17T02:05)
- Checked rollout status: /ops/rollouts -> a canary rollout of embedding-encoder v1.3.0->v1.3.1 was in progress around 2026-03-16 21:50 UTC. One older node remained unschedulable; autoscaler restarted it with stale image (2026-03-17T02:30)
- Reviewed autoscaler/rolling update events: kubectl describe daemonset/encoder -> showed eviction and 'failed to pull image' error for one zone; later pulled older image from local cache (2026-03-17T02:45)

Intermediate conclusions:
- Evidence strongly points to a partial rollout / mixed-version scenario where a subset of encoder workers emit 768-dim embeddings while rerank consumers expect 1536. That explains the direct dimension mismatch errors.
- Latency spikes likely secondary: when mismatch occurs, rerank service triggers validation, does fallback (CPU scoring or full re-encoding), or retries which increases end-to-end latency and queues on GPU workers.

Immediate mitigations taken:
- Added a temporary filter in the ingestion layer to reject embeddings where length != expected (1536) with metric increment and drop (2026-03-17T03:10). This reduces error propagation to downstream rerank (note: could increase client error rate).
- Scaled up rerank-gpu-prod-2 pool by +2 pods to relieve queueing (2026-03-17T03:25).
- Rolled back encoder rollout to v1.2.9 across all zones (2026-03-17T04:00) to restore homogeneous behavior.

Follow-ups / open action items:
- Ops: validate all nodes report model-version via consistent metadata (kube probe) and add a rollout pre-check to ensure no stale cached images exist on nodes. (owner: Ayan)
- Engineering: add runtime assertion at encoder output to tag embeddings with model-version & dim in-metadata so mismatches are surfaced earlier in logs and in tracing (owner: Samira).
- Product: verify whether embeddings-v1.3.x changes (1536 dim) were communicated to all integration owners; update migration doc and client compatibility notes. (owner: Maya)
- SRE: add alert for embedding-size variance > 0.1% over 5m window and an automated circuit-breaker that refuses mismatched embeddings at the gateway. (owner: Ryan)
- Postmortem: capture timeline, root cause, and recommend improvements to rollout automation + image caching strategy. P0 draft due by 2026-03-19.

Debug snippets / logs (redacted):
- error snippet: "[2026-03-16T22:58:07Z] ERROR rerank - dimension mismatch: expected=1536 actual=768 client_id=proj-93e7"
- sample payload (redacted): {client_id: "proj-93e7", embedding_len: 768, model_tag: "encoder:v1.2.9", request_id: "req-1a2b3c"}
- kubectl snippet: "kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=encoder -o wide" -> shows pod encoder-abc123 IMAGE=registry.redwood/encoder:v1.2.9 (zone-b), encoder-def456 IMAGE=registry.redwood/encoder:v1.3.1 (zone-a)

Notes to self (things to check next):
- Confirm if any downstream indexing jobs accepted 768-dim vectors and rebuilt parts of the index (faiss shards). If so, will need to reindex or patch those shards.
- Walkthrough of deployment pipeline: why did an older image remain and then be used from cache? Check daemonset vs deployment differences and nodeImagePullPolicy.
- Correlate with customer's traffic patterns: are a specific set of clients hitting the legacy path? (maybe mobile SDKs pinned to older client libs)
- Add unit/integration test to CI that simulates mixed-dim embeddings and validates clean failure modes.

Status update for incident channel (to paste):
- Root cause likely a partial rollout that created mixed encoder versions -> 768-dim embeddings introduced into pipeline.
- Mitigations: ingress filter and rollback applied, scaled pool to reduce queueing.
- Next: verify index integrity, tighten rollout prechecks, add alerting for embedding-dim variance.

Timestamped checkpoints (for postmortem):
- 2026-03-16T21:50 UTC: rollout of encoder v1.3.x started
- 2026-03-16T22:30 UTC: first errors observed in Sentry/monitoring
- 2026-03-17T01:22 UTC: discovered mixed model versions on GPU pods
- 2026-03-17T03:10 UTC: ingress filter enabled
- 2026-03-17T04:00 UTC: rollback to v1.2.9 completed

If anyone else is triaging, check logs under /var/log/rerank/errors.log and ingestion metrics in graphite.metrics.rerank.embedding_len_dist. I pushed a temporary dashboard under https://grafana.internal/d/abcd-embed where we can watch the dim distribution.

-- Ryan
